𝗦𝗔𝗤𝗜𝗕 𝗞𝗛𝗔𝗡: 𝟳 𝗪𝗜𝗖𝗞𝗘𝗧𝗦 𝗢𝗡 𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧! 🔥

Pakistan v Sri Lanka, 1st Test drawn in Rawalpindi.
Saqib took 7 wickets and won Player of the Match.

Debut to remember 👏

#PAKvSL #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧 𝗣𝗘 𝟳 𝗪𝗜𝗖𝗞𝗘𝗧𝗦! 🔥🏏

👉 Saqib Khan ne Rawalpindi Test mein debut pe 7 wicket liye
👉 Pakistan 434/9d & 284/8, Sri Lanka 446
👉 Dhananjaya 167 aur Kusal Mendis 119 ke baad bhi match draw
👉 Saqib bane Player of the Match

Kya Saqib agle Test mein bhi chalenge? Comment karo 👇
